_comment: Copy of this becomes macros.json (personal, not tracked). char = full character name e.g. 'Firstname Surname' (spaces/hyphens/case ignored) or omit for an account-wide macro. icon = number | 'spell:Name' | 'icon:file_name' | omit. The watcher fills in 'classes' automatically from /mf ask; for hand-written macros add "classes": {"Firstname Surname": "mage"} so `check` can verify spell names.
